senses.gloss: €2P. [उद्-हन्] To raise up, elevate (fig. also) [[Rv. 10. 102. 7.]] Ā. To kill one's self; [[Rām.]]; [[Pt.]] see उद्धत.

p. p. 
__1 Raised up, elevated, lifted up; लाड्गूलमुद्धतं धुन्वन् [[Bk. 9. 7]]; आत्मोद्धतैरपि रजोभिः [[Ś. 1. 8.]] raised; खुर° [[R. 9. 50]], heaved; [[Ki. 8. 53.]] 
__2 Excessive, very much, exceeding. 
__3 Haughty, vain, puffed up; प्रहितो राबणेनैष सह वीरैर्मदोद्धतैः [[Rām. 5. 58. 130.]] अक्षबधोद्धतः [[R. 12. 63.]] 
__4 Harsh; बचनै रसतां महीयसो न खलु व्येति गुरुत्वमुद्धतैः [[Śi. 16. 27.]] 
__5 Excited, inflamed, intensified; °मनोभवरागा [[Ki. 9. 68]], 69; मदोद्धताः प्रत्यनिलं बिचेरुः [[Ku. 3. 31]], 
__6 Majestic, stately; ill-mannered. 
__7 Abounding in, full; ततस्तु धारोद्धतमेघकल्पम् [[Rām. 6. 67. 142.]] 
__8 Eager, ready; युद्धोद्धतकृतोत्साहः संग्रामं सम्प्रपद्यत [[Rām. 5. 48. 16.]] 
__9 Shining, glittering; अन्योन्यं रजसा तेन कौशेयोद्धतपाण्डुना [[Rām. 6. 55. 19.]] 
-तः A king's wrestler. 
-Comp. 
-मनस्, -मनस्क a. high-minded, haughty, proud, °त्वम् Pride.

f. 
__1 Elevation. 
__2 Pride, haughtiness; नैवोद्धतिमाजगाम [[Śi. 3. 28.]] 
__3 Rudeness, insolence; नयति द्रुतमुद्धतिश्रितः 16. 72. 
__4 A stroke, shaking.
See under उद्ध्मा.

a. [उद्--ध्मा--श] Sounding, blowing. 
-मः 
__1 Sounding, blowing. 
__2 Breathing hard, panting.

उद्धर,
 
-उद्धार See under उद्धृ.

a. Delighted, glad; पतिमागतमाकर्ण्य पत्न्युद्धर्षाऽतिसम्भ्रमा [[Bhāg. 10. 81. 25.]] 
-र्षः 
__1 Great joy or delight. 
__2 Courage or energy to undertake a thing; अमर्षजनितोद्धर्षाश्चकुः कर्माण्यभीतवत् [[Rām. 6. 52. 6.]] 
__3 A festival (especially a religious one). 
__4 Excess, abundance; (उद्रेक); आपूर्यत बलो द्धर्षैर्वायुबेगैरिवार्णवः [[Rām. 6. 74. 35.]]

a. Animating, encouraging, exciting; हितमुद्धर्षणं चैव उबाच प्रथितं वचः [[Rām.]] निदर्शनान्युपायांश्च बहून्युद्धर्षणानि च [[Mb. 5. 135. 32.]] 
-णम् 
__1 Animating. 
__2 Erection of the hair (on the body), thrill.

a. 
__1 Encouraging. 
__2 (Ved.) One whose hair is erect.

__1 A sacrificial fire. 
__2 A festival, holiday. 
__3 N. of a Yādava, uncle and friend of Kṛṣṇa. [When Kṛṣṇa was taken by Akrūra to Maṭhurā, Uddhava was implored by the citizens of Gokula to go and fetch him. He was very much attached to Kṛṣṇa. On seeing the destruction of the Yādavas to be inevitable, he went to Kṛṣṇa and asked him what to do; whereupon he was told to go to Badarikāśrama to practise penance and to secure heaven. He is the subject of two short poems, उद्धबदूत and उद्धबसंदेश.
a. Extending or raising the hands.

I, 3 P. Ved. 
__1 To abandon or expose (an infant). 
__2 To set up, erect, build. II. 3 Ā. 
__1 To go or move upwards, rise (as the sun, dust &c.); यतो स्जः पार्थिवमुज्जिहीते [[R. 13. 64]]; [[Mu. 4. 21]]; [[Bk. 18. 27]]; [[N. 22. 45]], 55. 
__2 To go away from, depart; उज्जिहानजीविताम् [[Māl. 10.]] 
__3 To raise; शिरसा यूपमुज्जिहीते [[Kāty.]] 
__4 To throw up, knit (as eyebrows); सौमित्रिरक्षिभ्रुवमुज्जिहानः [[Bk. 3. 47.]]

a. 
__1 Ejected, vomited. 
__2 Inflated, corpulent, fat. 
__3 Gone up, ascended, risen. 
-नम्

__3 Abandonment, leaving.

p. p. Set up, erected.

a. Ejected, vomited. 
-तः An elephant out of rut (from whose temples ichor ceases to flow).

a. [उद्गता धूरस्मात्] 
__1 Freed from a burden or yoke, unrestrained, unchecked, free. cf. सैन्धबाः समरोद्धुराः [[Śiva B. 9. 65]]; also सङ्गरोद्धुराः ibid. 25. 19. 
__2 Firm, intrepid, bold; अभियोग° [[Mv. 6.]] 
__3 Victorious, conquering. 
__4 High, loud (voice &c.); पितरमुद्धुरध्वनिमहाजनानुयातमानीय [[Dk. 104.]] 
__5 Heavy, full of; जग्मे जयोद्धुरविशालविषाणमुक्ष्णा [[Śi. 5. 64.]] 
__6 Thick, gross. 
__7 Lively, cheerful. 
__8 Able, competent; मृद्वीकामधुमाधुरीमदपरीहारोद्धुराणां गिराम् [[Bv. 4. 40.]]

€5, 9 U. 
__1 To shake, move up, raise, throw up, wave (as a chawari); कैर्नोद्धूतानि चामराणि [[K. 117]], 200; [[Ku. 2. 29]]; उद्धूनीयात सत्केतून् [[Bk. 19. 8]]; [[Ki. 5. 39.]] 
__2 To shake or throw off; संमार्जन्यो नूनमुद्धूयमाना भान्ति स्मोच्चैः केतनानां पताकाः [[Śi. 18. 8]] dispel, destroy (fig.); उद्धूतपापाः [[Me. 57.]] 
__6 To disturb, excite, rouse up.

p. p. 
__1 Shaken off, fallen from; raised or thrown up; मारुतभरोद्धूतोऽपि धूलिव्रजः [[Dhan. V.]] 
__2 Exalted, high, loud. 
__3 Ruffled, tossed up; उद्धूतमिब सागरम् [[Mb. 5. 193. 4.]] 
__4 Blossomed, cheerful; आसीद्वनमिवोद्धूत स्त्रीवनं रावणस्य तत् [[Rām. 5. 9. 66.]] 
__5 High, gone up (उन्नत); देबदारुभिरुद्धूतैरूर्ध्वबाहुमिव स्थितम् [[Rām. 5. 56. 29.]] 
-तम् 
__1 Stamping. 
__2 Throwing up. 
__3 Turning up; digging.

__1 Throwing upwards, raising. 
__2 Shaking.
Fumigating.

__1 Powdering, sprinkling with dust or powder; भस्मोद्धूलन भद्रमस्तु भबने [[K. P. 10]]; [[K. 129.]] 
__2 An article used to season food.
Den. P. To powder, sprinkle with powder or dust.
Erection of the hair (on the body), thrill, horripilation.
a. Having the hairs erect (through joy); [[Pt. 1.]]

I. 1. 10 P. 
__1 To draw out, raise up. .__2 To save, deliver; भगवति तब स्पृष्टानद्भिश्चिरादुददीधरत् [[U. 1. 23.]] II. [उद्-हृ] .__1 To draw or take out, extract, extricate; शरं … उद्धर्तुमैच्छत् [[R. 2. 30]]; 3. 64; to deliver from, relieve of, save, rescue, protect (with abl.); मां तावदुद्धर शुचो दयिताप्रवृत्त्या [[V. 4. 31]]; [[Pt. 1. 358]]; [[Bg. 6. 5.]] 
__2 To uproot, extirpate, eradicate; tear or pull out; नमयामास नृपाननुद्धरन् [[R. 8. 9]], 4. 66; त्रिदिबमुद्धृतदानवकण्टकम् [[Ś. 7. 3]]; [[Mv. 3. 13]]; [[Māl. 9. 22]]; उद्धरणीये चक्षुषी [[Dk. 102.]] 
__3 To pluck up (flowers &c.); [[K. 21]], 144. 
__4 To raise, lift up, elevate, extend (as hands); पातयितुमेव शक्तिर्नान्नपिटमुद्धर्तुम् [[Pt. 1. 363]]; [[Ms. 4. 62]]; [[V. 4. 34.]] 
__5 To take up, absorb (water); उद्धरिष्यन्रसानिव [[R. 4. 66]]; उद्धृत्य मेघैस्तत एव तोयम् [[Śi. 3. 75.]] 
__6 To sustain, bear up; राज्यधुरमुद्धर्तुम् [[Pt. 1.]] 
__7 To separate, abstract. 
__8 To remove, put away. 
__9 To deduct, subtract. विट्पण्यमुद्धृतोद्धारं बिकेयं बित्तवर्धनम् [[Ms. 10. 85.]] 
__10 To select, pick out; एवं समुद्धतोद्धारे समानंशान्प्रकल्पयेत् [[Ms. 9. 116.]] 
__11 To present, [Page0429-2] offer; [[Y. 1. 159.]] 
__12 To prove; आगमस्तु कृतो येन सोऽभियुक्तस्तमुद्धरेत् [[Y. 2. 28.]] 
__13 To divide (as with partners). 
__14 To publish, make known. 
__15 To undo, destroy; एष त्वां सजनामात्यमुद्धरामि स्थिरो भव [[Mb. 5. 189. 23.]] -- Caus. To cause to extract or draw out; शल्यं निखातमुदहारयतामुरस्तः [[R. 9. 78.]]

__1 Drawing or taking out, taking off (clothes &c.). 
__2 Extraction, pulling or tearing out; कण्टक° [[Ms. 9. 252]]; चक्षुषोरुद्धरणम् [[Mit.]]; so शल्य°. 
__3 Extricating, deliverance, rescuing (from danger); दीनोद्धरणोचितस्य [[R. 2. 25]]; स बन्धुर्यो विपन्नानामापदुद्धरणक्षमः [[H. 1. 29.]] 
__4 Destruction, eradication, extermination, deposition, dethronement; चन्द्रगुप्तस्योद्धरणात् [[Mu. 4.]] 
__5 Lifting, raising. 
__6 Taking a part or share. 
__7 Taking from the Gārhapatya fire to supply the other sacred fires. 
__8 Vomiting; जग्धस्य मोहाद्धि बिशुद्धिमन्धसो जुगुप्सितस्योद्धरणं प्रचक्षते [[Bhāg. 4. 4. 18.]] 
__9 Anything vomited. 
__10 Final emancipation. 
__11 Acquittance of debt. 
__12 Hoping, expecting; अपि ते ब्राह्मणा भुक्त्वा गताः सोद्धरणान् गृहान् [[Mb. 13. 60. 14.]]

__1 Raising, elevating. 
__2 Rescuing, drawing out of (danger), delivering. 
__3 Sharing, dividing.

उद्धर्तृ,
उद्धारक a. 
__1 One who raises or lifts up. 
__2 A sharer, co-heir. 
__3 One who recovers property. m. 
__1 A destroyer, exterminator; [[Y. 2. 271.]] 
__2 A saviour, deliverer.
m. Mode of giving or paying; तत्कथय कथमस्योद्धारकविधिर्भबिष्यति [[Pt. 2.]]

__1 Drawing out, extraction. 
__2 Deliverance, redemption, saving, rescuing, extrication. 
__3 Raising, lifting up. 
__4 Deduction, a part to be set aside. 
__5 (In law) A part to be set aside from the paternal property for the benefit of the eldest son; the surplus allowed by law to the eldest beyond the shares of the younger brothers; ज्येष्ठस्य विंश उद्धारः सर्बद्रव्याच्च यद्वरम् [[Ms. 9. 112.]] 
__6 The sixth part of booty taken in war which belongs to the king; राज्ञश्च दद्युरुद्धारमित्येषा बैदिकी श्रुतिः [[Ms. 7. 97.]] 
__7 An obligation. 
__8 Debt, particularly such as bears no interest. 
__9 Recovering property. 
__10 Marching out. 
__11 Citing (a passage), quoting. 
__12 Final beatitude. 
__13 Prosperity, elevation. 
__14 Compilation. 
__15 Leavings of dishes.
